category_name: Supplication of the resident for the traveller
title: Supplication of the resident for the traveller - Hisn al-Muslim 101
arabic: أَسْتَـوْدِعُ اللَّهَ ديـنَكَ وَأَمانَتَـكَ، وَخَـواتيـمَ عَمَـلِك
transliteration: Astawdi`ullāha dīnak, wa amānatak, wa khawātīma `amalik.
translation: I leave your religion in the care of Allah, as well as your safety, and the last of your deeds.
tags: Supplication of the resident for the traveller

category_name: Supplication of the resident for the traveller
title: Supplication of the resident for the traveller - Hisn al-Muslim 101
arabic: زَوَّدَكَ اللَّهُ التقْوى، وَغَفَـرَذَنْـبَكَ، وَيَسَّـرَ لَكَ الخَـيْرَ حَيْـثُما كُنْـت
transliteration: Zawwadaka 'llāhut-taqwā, wa ghafara dhanbak, wa yassara laka 'l-khayra ḥaythu mā kunt.
translation: May Allah give you piety as your provision, forgive your sins, and make goodness easy for you wherever you are.
tags: Supplication of the resident for the traveller
